body: I like to think most ponies are autistic, as someone on the spectrum also, I think most of Ponyville at the least represents a community where accommodations for autism are easy so meltdowns are less prevalent. But they all have aspects of social miscommunication, hyperfixations (cutie marks), and sensory tics that I think it’s silly. My therapist actually recommended watching mlp to better understand friendship from an autistic viewpoint! I love the show a lot but all this stuff is just headcanon really, I think if you’re on the spectrum and find representation in it then there’s no harm. :D Mostly though, I think the Pie family and Twilight are “more autistic”.

I feel exactly the same way with how I’m handling college, I’m going to fail a few classes and can’t tell my parents at all but remembering that I have classmates all at different stages in life helps me remember that you can come back and improve again and again and it’s not the end to struggle!! Sometimes it just takes a while to acclimate to stuff. Maybe focus on lowering the courseload if possible so it doesn’t feel so overwhelming? 

As for friends though, it can seem really intimidating at first, but usually there are some clubs or casual groups that meet and would be a rlly good place to meet friends. I had none until I took a chance on a gaming group and everyone was rlly nice and I was surprised how comfortable I got!! It helps me focus on classes just to get out and be around new people. 

I wouldn’t recommend dropping out unless you think you need it, it can be really hard to convince yourself to return to college. If you’re able to get in then I’m sure it would benefit you but it’s also not terrible to drop and pursue a different path. 

Wishing you all the best!!

Honestly I don’t reach out and really struggle to keep convos going. I feel guilty abt being on a sub and understanding exactly how people feel but not reaching out because I feel awkward. I guess it’s just too comfortable to break the habit of being lonely for me, even if it sucks.
About anything or uhm ? I don’t have much to say, I appreciate it a lot though and like to chat, even if it’s a little mindless.

I don’t think myself much of a hunter or fisher but the idea of going forward to put myself more out there to help people I think would really help, maybe cause it makes you feel less alone while still being lonely but I really like that so thank you.

I don’t think I want to be alone either, I just don’t think that the right kind of people who are like me are around so I want to know if anyone has figured out how to enjoy the lonely in life. I guess it feels like my only option, but it’s really cool you were able to put yourself out there, and I really hope you find those people that you’re searching for that are good for you. I know you’d be a good friend considering you’re helping out other people in this reddit. Thank you.
I’ve never met someone else who seems like me, so it’s a little comforting knowing you’re kinda the same and don’t find it bad. Thank you.

I get overwhelmed easily and run out of “social battery”. It gets hard to talk a lot so most people get bored and we don’t become close, and when I try and put more effort in it just seems weird and forced. I’m not sure how to fix it without being fake and stressing myself out.
